//: Hybrid Workforce Security — scenario definitions used by the module UI. Each scenario lists which of the 6 enforcement domains are active and which deliverables apply.

scenarios.title: Café / airport road-warrior
scenarios.persona: FTE laptop user (Windows + iPhone), untrusted Wi-Fi, removable USB drive, occasional travel into restricted geos.
enforcement: BitLocker (boot + removable) enforced via intune-oma-uri.xml
EDR onboarded; Defender telemetry streaming to SIEM
ZTNA/SASE gate active; CA blocks non-compliant device from SaaS
Clipboard isolation on; paste to personal web apps blocked
Sign-in risk policy forces phishing-resistant MFA on medium+ risk
Geofenced: web app access outside trusted region → report-only first

scenarios.title: BYOD contractor
scenarios.persona: External contractor, personal device, VDI/container access only — never sensitive local storage.
enforcement: No local data: container/VDI mode via managed browser
MDM/MAM container profile + app-level policies (managed browser only)
Conditional Access marks personal devices 'compliant' only for sandboxed apps
Copy/paste intentionally blocked between work container and personal apps
Contract access expires at engagement end (JIT expiry on the device group)

scenarios.title: Head-office worker
scenarios.persona: Fully managed corporate desktop, trusted office LAN/PAN, badge access.
enforcement: Full disk encryption + locked screensaver (Jamf com.apple.screensaver / 10-min GPO)
EDR + SIEM correlation; USB control (write-block for unauthorised classes)
Physical-context control: office sessions inherit a lower-risk trust rating
Printer/share access tied to device ID + badge role

scenarios.title: Lost or stolen device
scenarios.persona: Device reported lost/stolen mid-session — legal hold + revocation, zero-trust re-onboarding.
enforcement: Immediate quarantine in ZTNA; token-strip via token-revoke.mjs
Full-disk encryption means the drive is unreadable offline
Remote wipe queued (Intune/Jamf) once confirmed lost
Re-onboarding requires new machine identity + phishing-resistant MFA
Incident filed under IR P1 (24h review window) with CAPA
